text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 358 Bartlett Avenue North for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the soft landscaping requirements on private property of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918 and the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where on-street permit parking is authorised on an the same side of the street and the installation of a permanent ramp would result in the loss of two permit parking spaces. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.

Etobicoke York Community Council approved the request for front yard parking at 358 Bartlett Avenue North, with the following conditions: 1. The parking area be a minimum of 2.2 metres in width and not exceed 2.35 metres and a minimum of 5.3 metres and not exceed 5.5 metres in length. 2. The applicant remove the existing asphalt and repave the parking area with semi-permeable paving materials, as indicated in Attachment 'A', attached to the report dated January 26, 2018, from the Manager, Right of Way Management, Transportation Services. 3. The applicant pay for the installation of the permanent ramp to service the parking space. 4. The applicant disconnect any downspouts, if feasible, or seek an exemption from Toronto Water in accordance with the requirements in Chapter 681-11(S). 5.
